en-US.longDescription: FireAlpaca is the free digital painting software compatible with both Mac and Windows, supporting 10 languages. The Windows 64-bit version runs on Windows 10 or later, and Windows, macOS, and Linux versions are all available for free. It provides a lightweight yet powerful painting environment with tools such as the Pose Doll 3D character posing, perspective rulers, a line stabilizer, and text tools.
en-US.name: FireAlpaca
